title: Derivative Scenes save wrongly typed arrays in .tscn file when exported arrays are empty
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducable in Godot 4.4 Beta 3


### System information

Windows 10 - Vulkan

### Issue description

When defining export typed Arrays for scenes derived from other scenes, there will be wrongly typed empty arrays saved in the export in the .tscn file, leading to a 

"E 0:00:00:0910   control.gd:6 @ _ready(): Cannot assign contents of "Array[String]" to "Array[int]".
  <C++-Fehler>   Method/function failed.
  <C++-Quelle>   core/variant/array.cpp:274 @ assign()
  <Stacktrace>   control.gd:6 @ _ready()"

on instantiating the scene

It seems to set empty typed array of the first defined export field for all the other array export fields (check reproduction steps)

But as soon as i add an element to any of the arrays, it will define a correct array for that specific export


This does not happen if the field is not defined as export via @export


### Steps to reproduce

When defining typed arrays in a script for a scene, it works all fine:

I have empty typed arrays in the scene: 

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e29679e2-a53d-4f57-ba26-ad9455ca6f67)

and in the .tscn file it looks like this:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/15b76d69-f535-4a90-84dc-877f926df0a7)

but as soon as i derive a scene from the data_object.tscn, when i do the same here:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6c6c9a5-20b6-49ed-8bb6-001523c3eabd)

as long as the arrays are empty it will save empty arrays of the wrong type in the .tscn files

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/86598dc0-8846-4a1c-a7cf-70ee2cb109ae)

and on instantiating that scene it will complain in the debugger:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4bb6f696-da4b-4fcb-b869-18b40a3351dc)

and as soon as i put at least one element of the array into the exported fields in the inspector and save:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c7d01d63-37d6-443d-9c90-c6c9a83b3b17)

no error will be thrown anymore

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d8fc193d-34d3-4973-a1a3-fd88ca06616a)

And seems like there is some extra fckery going on, with the array type that was defined in the highest line in the script, will be used to create a typed array for all the empty exports following, being defined in the derived Object and extended script:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/51639e46-8772-4756-b068-0c44a66781ac)

resulting in:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1e155a2f-d05b-4f11-afb8-cc52897e2048)

throwing different but the same type of error:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f6360159-bcdd-40cd-a765-ee8deb252100)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[reproduction_array_string_in_array_int.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/18757370/reproduction_array_string_in_array_int.zip)

Just run the project and you will encounter the error in the debugger
